title: Reach End of Array With Max Score
summary: Given an integer array nums, starting at index 0, jump to indices greater than the current one.
statement: Given an integer array nums, starting at index 0, jump to indices greater than the current one. The score for each jump is (j - i) * nums[i], where i is the current index and j is the destination index. Find the maximum total score to reach the last index.
constraints: From i, jump to any j>i and gain (j-i)*nums[i].
Start at index zero and reach the final index with maximum total score.
hints: Split any jump into unit distances; its source value is paid once for every crossed boundary.
For each boundary, use the greatest value available on its left.
Scan nums except the last, maintain a prefix maximum, and add it.
Choosing the prefix maximum at each boundary can be realized by jumping when that maximum first becomes available.
editorial: Choosing the prefix maximum at each boundary can be realized by jumping when that maximum first becomes available.

tests.explanation: Jump 0-1 and then 1-3 for scores one and six, totaling seven.
Using value four across all four index steps yields total sixteen.
